cues.en: In this section, we going to be using Streamlit, which is an open source framework for developing apps with Python.
cues.zh: 這一節會使用 Streamlit，它是用 Python 開發應用程式的開源框架。

cues.en: And if you want to install Streamlit on your local machine, you can just use PIP.
cues.zh: 如果想在本機安裝 Streamlit，直接使用 pip 即可。

cues.en: So pip install Streamlit and then to get Streamlit up and running we can go to our terminal and run Streamlit.
cues.zh: 執行 pip install streamlit，然後到終端機輸入 streamlit

cues.en: Then what it's going to do is open up a demo example within my browser.
cues.zh: 接著，它會在瀏覽器中開啟示範程式。

cues.en: All right, So we've got our demo application up and running and we can see there's quite a lot of functionality that's available to us.
cues.zh: 好，示範應用程式已經執行起來，可以看到有很多可用的功能。

cues.en: We've got different toggles and interactive plots and widgets and so on.
cues.zh: 例如各種切換控制、互動圖表與元件等等。

cues.en: And this is very powerful because it allows you to develop an interactive dashboard of sorts with a lot of different features that we can use to augment our machine learning processes.
cues.zh: 這非常強大，因為它能讓你開發具有多種功能的互動式儀表板，用來輔助機器學習流程。

cues.en: So in the context of fraud detection, we can set up a simple dashboard that allows us to toggle the
cues.zh: 以詐欺偵測為例，可以建立簡單的儀表板，讓我們調整

cues.en: threshold of our fraud detection model to compare different versions of our models to apply a total
cues.zh: 詐欺偵測模型的門檻、比較不同模型版本，並替各種錯誤分類指定成本，

cues.en: cost of fraud to our different misclassifications to work out a total cost of fraud as well.
cues.zh: 進一步計算詐欺總成本。
